classification_contract.SOURCE_EXPLICIT: The source says this directly. Wording may be shortened without changing meaning.
classification_contract.PAGE_MODEL_CANDIDATE: The source provides evidence, but the page's documented model step must translate it into the V7 field shape and the creator must review it.
classification_contract.PAGE_TEST_ACTOR_ACTION: The test actor uses an already documented page review, approve, return, or confirm control. This is not source data, a new default, or a bypass of the product state transition.
classification_contract.CREATOR_REQUIRED: The source does not define the value, defines an ambiguity, or does not authorize the V7 semantic choice. Do not invent it.
classification_contract.PRODUCT_DEFAULT: The creator has approved this editable product default independently of the source document.
classification_contract.format_normalization: A separate note used only for non-semantic page or enum formatting. It never upgrades a candidate into a source fact.

source_section: 一、核心一句话（剥削熵增定律）
creative_origin.paste_material: 作品名《熔炼末世》。核心命题是：末世真正的敌人是资源递减后自动重建的吃人秩序；文明是否能靠工程、制度和协作打破这种‘剥削熵增定律’。主角江枫以工业工程和‘熔炼’能力建设可复制的生产与防御体系；叶凡以随身空间、存量物资和效率暴力建立资源堡垒。两人互相需要，又因‘创造与给予’对‘控制与占有’的文明路线必然冲突。

title.format_normalization: Remove Chinese book-title brackets for the page title field only.

intent_json.genre_main.reason: The source mixes apocalypse, implanted locks, alien-origin clues, powers, and industrial engineering but never declares one V7 main genre.

forbid_json.reason: Energy costs and setting rules are world facts, not creator red lines. The model may return a reviewable candidate or a controlled missing-field result, but the fixture must not turn those world facts into a red line or supply an empty-value default.

source_section: 2.2 末世起源（三阶段时间线）
2.3 晶核体系（能量守恒核心）
world_setting.paste_material: 世界规则：人类基因中的‘锁’限制能量与物质操控；晶核只转移和耗散能量，不凭空生产；全球晶核能量持续递减。2030 年‘钥匙’扩散到东半球，多数错误解锁者丧尸化，少数正确解锁者觉醒异能。丧尸分力量、敏捷、智慧三类进化，最高五级；异能也最高五级，单人最多叠加三种。江枫的熔炼空间可重构物质但消耗晶核并受每日次数限制；叶凡的随身空间用于存取与资源控制。主要组织为火种计划、安全屋、精英金字塔和海盗船，分别代表制度生产、资源垄断、等级特权和暴力掠夺。

source_section: 3.2 江枫：失业工程师 → 规则制定者
character_setting_core.paste_material: 江枫，28 岁，末世前是智能制造高级工程师，末世后成为火种计划的规则制定者与技术架构师。他沉默务实、数据驱动，想用可复制的生产、制度与协作证明普通人也能活下去；核心能力是物质重构型‘熔炼’。叶凡，26 岁但带有重生经历，前世为求生小队后勤队长，今生以随身空间和存量物资建立安全屋，信奉资源控制、先知特权和效率暴力。叶凡需要江枫把废铁变成生产力；江枫需要叶凡的库存和前期保护。合作会因奴隶制对雇佣制、存量争夺对生产增量、控制对共生而破裂。

character_setting_supporting.paste_material: 江枫阵营包括：负责能源调度且会过载的吴芮；能读心、维护制度又面临隐私伦理冲突的苏婉清；商业与外交担当王大伟；部署在机器人中的剪枝算法‘二狗子’。叶凡阵营包括：以武力维持安全屋的周瑶；将人视作生物材料的外科医生林薇；执行压榨的李彪。外部角色包括中立情报商老鬼、精英金字塔领袖戚国防和海盗船首领包万里。请保持他们的阵营、能力、价值冲突和功能定位，不要生成文档未给出的记忆、知识边界或关系数值。

source_section: 3.6 叙事钩子与剧情爆发点
conflict_seed.paste_material: 核心冲突种子是江枫与叶凡的文明路线之争。前期叶凡提供钢材和废弃车辆，江枫熔炼成自动防御设施，两人合作抵御尸潮；中期基地扩张后，叶凡主张奴隶制和按劳动力等级分配，江枫主张雇佣制、信用点和循环生产；后期叶凡必须在重复前世的封闭安全与拿出库存共同建设之间选择。文档还给出从晶核递减、丧尸可文明化、锁被植入到外部测试目的的长期揭露阶梯，但没有指定单章范围。

minimum_runnable_journey.goal: Exercise the real source text -> model candidate -> page review -> FP001-07 atomic new-book journey without prebuilding a business payload.
steps: Enter the source-explicit title and creative-origin material.
Paste the world, character, and conflict materials into the current chat in their corresponding stages.

Review the page-model extraction: seven world boards, complete character V7 shape, relation dimensions, initial memory candidates, and an initial L1A candidate must come from the workflow rather than this fixture.
Use the existing reviewed stage locks and final confirm button.
Verify one FP001-07 atomic success with a current-book context, or a controlled workflow/page rejection with no partial book.
minimum_runnable_journey.expected_result: The fixture contributes only source text. The product either atomically creates one book from model-produced, page-reviewed data or rejects it without a partial book; it must not convert fixture content into a direct RPC payload.

complete_journey.goal: Create one source-backed book and produce 10 consecutive formal chapters through the real product pages.
prerequisites: FP001-03 returns complete, contract-valid candidates from the source material; its output is reviewed with the existing page controls rather than hand-filled by the fixture.
The active model/prompt binding is available to ZH01, WORLD, CHARACTER, ZH02, and ZH03.
The source ambiguity in the duplicated 5.1 name is omitted or returned as a controlled candidate diagnostic; it is not auto-corrected into a relation.
The current page/workflow implementation exposes the documented L1A sort/review/lock, production approval, deduction review, audit confirmation, and formal-commit actions.
steps: Verify and, if necessary, repair formal world items through /books/{book_id}/world.
Verify and, if necessary, repair formal characters through /books/{book_id}/characters.
Generate, review, sort, and lock one L1A through /books/{book_id}/l1a.
Select it and approve a generated presentation plan through /books/{book_id}/production.
Observe the isolated multi-character run through /books/{book_id}/deduction.
Approve or return the real result through /books/{book_id}/deduction-review.
Generate prose, review audit evidence, decide, and formally commit through /books/{book_id}/audit.

Repeat the documented L1A, production, deduction, prose, audit, and commit journey as required until the same book has formal chapter indexes 1 through 10; do not assume one L1A always contains 10 chapters.
current_runtime_blocks: The L1A page explicitly disables variant generation and three-line sorting when the stable workflow contract is unavailable.
The production page explicitly disables production start, approval, and return actions while their contract is not connected.
The deduction page disables pause/regenerate controls without a stable contract.
The deduction-review page disables approve/return controls while orchestration is unavailable.
The audit page disables release/return controls while audit orchestration is unavailable.
V7 leaves change_limit comparison semantics and the Chinese word-count rule unresolved; this fixture does not invent either.
